name: CARES
description: CARES is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the trustworthiness of Medical Large Vision Language Models (Med-LVLMs) across five dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, privacy, and robustness. It includes about 41K question-answer pairs in both closed and open-ended formats, covering 16 medical image modalities and 27 anatomical regions.
reputation: A recent and comprehensive benchmark for medical LVLM trustworthiness that is gaining attention for its broad coverage of safety, fairness, privacy, and robustness.
notes: Focuses on trustworthiness aspects including fairness, safety, privacy, and robustness in medical vision-language models.
